title: LeakageBench-MIDI: Measuring and Mitigating Same-Work Family Leakage in Symbolic Music Generation
description: A public-safe strong-reproduction release for measuring and mitigating same-work family leakage in symbolic music generation evaluation. It includes reusable code, anonymous minimum-sufficient analysis units, field-by-field statistical recomputation, final tables and figures, and automated integrity checks. No original LMD or PDMX music data, token sequences, or model checkpoints are redistributed.

creators.name: Bai, Kun
creators.affiliation: School of Intelligence Science and Technology, Beijing University of Civil Engineering and Architecture, Beijing 102616, China

notes: Frozen formal results and protocol are unchanged. The family graph is a reference known-family relation, not a universal detector.
